test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As of July 2022, under the “Nai Manzil' Scheme of the Ministry of Minority Affairs, the participant will get non-residential integrated education and skill training programme for 9 to 12 months of which a minimum _________ months should be devoted to skill training.
solution:
The correct answer is __**three**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Three months** should be devoted to skill training under the "Nai Manzil" Scheme.
 
• The "Nai Manzil" Scheme is an initiative by the Ministry of Minority Affairs aimed at providing non-residential integrated education and skill training to minority youth.
 
• The program duration ranges from 9 to 12 months, ensuring participants gain both educational and vocational skills.
 
• This scheme helps bridge the gap between education and employability for minority communities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The "Nai Manzil" Scheme focuses on enhancing the overall employability of minority youth by integrating academic education and skill training.
 
• The program also includes soft skills and personality development training to ensure holistic development.
 
• Participants are awarded certificates upon successful completion, which can aid in better employment opportunities.
 
• The Ministry of Minority Affairs continuously monitors the scheme to ensure its effectiveness and reach among the targeted beneficiaries.
